info.title: Embodied DataOps API
info.description: Multimodal embodied-data production platform: imports, canonical episodes, quality reports, review, dataset versions and feedback orders.

get.description:

Prometheus scrapes without an API key, so anonymous access is limited to
internal (loopback/private) clients; external callers must present an
admin key.

AnnotationRevisionDetection.title: AnnotationRevisionDetection
AnnotationRevisionDetection.description:
One detection inside a ``annotation-revision/2.0`` frame.

Coordinates must satisfy SPEC §4.2: ``0 <= x1 < x2 <= 640`` and
``0 <= y1 < y2 <= 480``.  ``score`` is ``null`` for a purely manual box.
